thread:
Maya: Heads up — nightly perf alert for the nightly-pipeline run. p95 token latency up ~28% vs baseline starting at 03:10 UTC. Dashboard: https://redwood-ci.internal/bench/3350006789 :warning:
ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf-job #4721 — p95 delta +28% — affected route: /runtime/generate (small-batch) — artifacts: https://ci-artifacts.internal/4721
Liam: I'll pick this up, putting a quick repro attempt on my laptop. can you paste the job id and the failing config?
Maya: job id 4721 (linked above). config: small-batch

```yaml
batch_size: 8
seq_len: 512
model_variant: gptx-4q-int8
prefill_cache: false
```

logs show repeated `kvcache: miss` lines around the spikes. snippet:

```text
[03:11:02] serve: started request id=abcd1234
[03:11:02] kvcache: miss key=ctx-9e...
[03:11:02] model: forward 12ms
[03:11:02] tail-latency p95=240ms
```

Noah: I can reproduce locally with the same config. quick hypothesis: KV cache eviction / cold-cache churn due to recent eviction tuning. pinging @Sophia for eviction metric history.
Sophia: saw the alert, checking. eviction-rate spiked at 03:09 on the node pool `nightly-2` — looks like the cache size calc regressed after commit `a1b2c3d` (recent memory safety fixes). pulling heap + eviction traces.
Anya: any chance this is a transient infra flake? we had control-plane restarts earlier this week. if it's commit-correlated we can do a rollback; if infra, we need ops runbook.
Liam: quick bisect plan: (1) repro locally with same artifact, (2) try serving with prev runtime image (tag `release-2026-03-15`) to see if spike disappears, (3) if stable, bisect commits between release and current image. starting step 2 now.
ci-bot: artifacts for #4721 uploaded: flamegraphs, perf-profiles, log bundles: https://ci-artifacts.internal/4721 (flame.svg, perf.pb)
Noah: grabbing flamegraph now — loading... looks like a hot-path inside `kv_cache::lookup` and `serve::serialize_shard` during prefix handling.
Maya: nice. Liam — what did step 2 show?
Liam: swapped in `release-2026-03-15` image for a quick canary run — p95 dropped back to baseline. so that narrows to a runtime change. bisecting between `release-2026-03-15` and `canary-2026-03-18`.
Sophia: confirm: commit `a1b2c3d` is in the window. I can open a hotfix PR to revert the eviction tweak and add a safety check. will do a small test in staging first.
Anya: if PR looks good, would prefer a targeted rollback on nightly only (no global rollback) — can we pin the nightly job image to the previous release until fix lands?
Liam: yes — can pin job via the nightly CI job config. I'll submit the pin change once Sophia posts the revert PR.
Maya: action items: Sophia to open revert PR + tests (owner Sophia). Liam to pin nightly job and continue bisect (owner Liam). Noah to draft a follow-up perf test to simulate cache churn (owner Noah). Anya to coordinate with infra if we need node-pool level mitigation. I'll post a short postmortem in the morning.
Sophia: opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1382 — title: "revert(kvcache): guard eviction-size-calc to avoid over-eviction" — adding unit test and an integration smoke. will request review from @Liam @Noah. :sparkles:
Liam: pinned nightly job to `release-2026-03-15` in CI config — rerunning the nightly job to confirm. if green, we leave pin in place until PR merges.
ci-bot: nightly run #4724 (pinned image) completed — p95 within baseline. result: PASS.
Noah: ran targeted perf test, simulating TTL churn — still reproduces on canary image. confirms eviction logic is the offender. adding test case to PR.
Maya: thanks team. Sophia please ping when PR is merged and we'll unpin. also add a changelog note so ops is aware.
Sophia: will do. planning to merge after a quick approval and one green integration job.
Anya: I'll add an ops alert to watch eviction-rate and node-level OOMs for the next 48h.
Liam: quick note for repo hygiene — adding a small comment in the commit that introduced the change to explain the revert reason.
Maya: summary for the thread: Root cause: eviction-size calc change in commit a1b2c3d caused over-eviction on small-batch workloads -> p95 spike. Mitigation: pin nightly image + revert PR. Next: add regression test and ikv warmup for small-batch jobs.
Sophia: merging PR now. :merge:
Maya: thanks all. I added the incident tag and will draft a short postmortem tomorrow AM. good catch. :thumbsup:
